name: wildvision-bench
description:
WildVision-Bench
	

We have two versions of Wildvision-Bench data

vision_bench_0617: the selected 500 examples that best simulates the vision-arena elo ranking, same data in the paper.
vision_bench_0701: the further filter and selected 500 examples by NSFW and manual selection. Leaderboard are still preparing.


	
		
		Evaluation
	

Please refer to our Github for evaluation
If you want to evaluate your model, please use the vision_bench_0617 version to fairly compare the performance… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/WildVision/wildvision-bench.
reputation: An emerging curated vision benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with an evolving leaderboard and growing community interest.
